new_load_idx = 'PQ_VERIFY_029_A'
new_load_bus = 4

andes.run_power_flow(ssa)

ssa.PQ.q.v *= scale_factor

min_bus_index = np.where(bus_voltages == min_voltage)[0][0]

}
